description: Fetch WakaTime coding durations (start/end timestamps with project and file) for a single day (date required, YYYY-MM-DD); optionally slice_by entity/language/branch for granular session data. Requires your own WakaTime personal OAuth token as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: durations
